attempt_rule: Store every attempted pair immutably; accept first quality-passing attempt in schedule order. No outcome-based retries. At most two attempts per trial, then stop for repair/new version.

baselines.acoustic_only: proposal from DoA speech activity without face synchrony
baselines.fused_abstaining: proposal only when speech, spatial and synchrony gates pass
baselines.non_abstaining_visible_face: proposal whenever one usable face is visible
baselines.spatial_only: proposal from face-DoA agreement without synchrony
baselines.speech_plus_mouth_activity: proposal from simultaneous speech and mouth activity without temporal synchrony
baselines.synchrony_only: proposal from audio-mouth synchrony without spatial agreement
baselines.visual_activity_only: proposal from lip activity without audio synchrony

candidate_grid.note: The wider lag grid is an instrument-transfer diagnostic. A wider lag is not accepted unless every development hard negative still abstains.

claim_boundary: Single-setup engineering pilot. No confirmation, liveness, safe motion, attention hold, response or end-to-end validation. Laptop audio remains external.

conditions.instruction: Face Reachy's camera at the fixed front mark and speak naturally for all ten seconds. Keep the phone silent. Playback conditions: restart the same recording immediately before Record, at the sealed volume, and let it play throughout.

Face Reachy. Speak naturally for seconds 0–3, stay silent for 3–5, then speak for 5–10. Keep the phone silent. Playback conditions: restart the same recording immediately before Record, at the sealed volume, and let it play throughout.

Remain silent with one face visible while the fixed phone recording plays from the colocated mark within 10 degrees of the face heading. Playback conditions: restart the same recording immediately before Record, at the sealed volume, and let it play throughout.

Mouth silently and deliberately out of time with the fixed phone recording; keep the phone on the colocated mark within 10 degrees of the face heading. Playback conditions: restart the same recording immediately before Record, at the sealed volume, and let it play throughout.
Keep one face visible to Reachy. Stay silent; no phone playback. Playback conditions: restart the same recording immediately before Record, at the sealed volume, and let it play throughout.

Speak live while keeping every face outside the camera view; do not use playback. Playback conditions: restart the same recording immediately before Record, at the sealed volume, and let it play throughout.

Stay silent with your face visible at the front mark. Play the fixed recording on the single iPhone at the 60-degree mark to Reachy's right. Playback conditions: restart the same recording immediately before Record, at the sealed volume, and let it play throughout.

development_selection_rule: require every development capture to pass its objective quality gates
require zero proposals for every development hard-negative/control trial
require at least three proposals across the four development positives
if no setting qualifies, conclude pilot failure without relaxing a gate
excluded: all commissioning captures and every laptop v1/v2 attempt; never import as pilot trials
experimental_unit: one ten-second trial, not telemetry rows or camera frames
internal_validation_rule: freeze the development-selected setting before opening repetition 3
require both matching-positive trials to propose
require every hard-negative/control trial to abstain
otherwise stop and revise the method in a new protocol version
opening_gate: matching execution manifest, private setup seal, verified microphone settings and next scheduled card; first trial remains closed until all pass

quality_gates.failed_capture_rule: retain the failed attempt privately, correct only the objective issue, and repeat the same scheduled trial before advancing

sensors.audio: external laptop microphone; not fully robot-native audiovisual sensing

threshold_basis: Retain v2 acquisition gates plus the original robot-camera transport/timing gates; no thresholds selected from pilot outcomes.

timing_analysis.audio: every 40-ms telemetry sample; timestamp = row time minus half the 2048-sample RMS window
timing_analysis.boundary_lag: report boundary hits; a selected boundary-lag result requires a new timing investigation, not a wider post-hoc grid
timing_analysis.mouth: one observation per distinct frame, timestamp = row time minus corrected local frame age
timing_analysis.resampling: common support only, 40-ms grid, linear interpolation; reject gaps over 160 ms before interpolation
timing_analysis.scope: lag includes unmeasured exposure/robot/network/decode delays; not sensor-exposure synchrony or liveness
timing_analysis.smoothing: apply candidate smoothing on the common 40-ms grid, not on duplicated camera rows

validation_lock: Do not open block 3 until all 14 development trials are accepted and their selected setting and source hashes are frozen. Evaluate block 3 once without reselection.
